course_info.faculty: Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences

catalog_course_description: Simulation Modeling and analysis of manufacturing and service systems; simulation modeling perspectives; discrete event simulation; simulation languages/ software; statistical aspects of simulation.
course_learning_outcomes: Describe the principles of simulation modeling and analysis for discrete event systems
Identify probability distributions and perform statistical analysis of both input and output data
Construct the computer-based simulation model for a given discrete event system
course_objective: By the end of this course, successful students should have learnt the principles of simulation, modelling, and statistical analysis for discrete event systems as well as the techniques and tools to apply those principles on a computer, in particular using the simulation software package ARENA.
